# A ref the checker types as a list is a list at run time, however many
# instances rendered. The interpreter's lookup answers one element as that
# element, so with a single child instance `c.lbl[0]` indexed a map and read
# nil, and `c.lbl.length()` answered 0.

sngl test --platform none refs.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

-- refs.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component child node {
    var count = 0

    button #inc(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
    text #lbl(value="{count}")
}

component one node {
    vbox {
        child()
    }
}

component none node {
    var shown = false

    if shown {
        child()
    }
}

func testOneDescendant(t Test, c one) {
    c.inc[0].click()
    t.assert(c.lbl[0].value == "1")
}

func testOneDescendantLength(t Test, c one) {
    t.assert(c.lbl.length() == 1)
}

func testNoDescendant(t Test, c none) {
    t.assert(c.lbl.length() == 0)
}
